description: Na₂CaNb₄Bi₂O₁₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmc2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.93 Å. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.80 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-34°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.14 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-27°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.27 Å. Bi is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.62 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ca and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na and two Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OBi₄ tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Ca and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Nb and two equivalent Bi atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two equivalent Nb atoms.
